sentences.text: Gemella species are fastidious gram-positive cocci that are typically commensal organisms but can become opportunistic pathogens.
A systematic review of 52 case reports of endocarditis due to Gemella species found G. morbillorum and G. haemolysans most prevalent, with a male predominance of 79.6 percent.
In bronchoalveolar lavage fluid from 72 intensive care patients, Gemella was detected in 9 patients with aspiration pneumonia, including 8 of 26 non-survivors and 1 of 23 survivors.
Gemella morbillorum has been described as an oropharyngeal commensal and reported as a rare cause of pleural empyema, a severe complication of pneumonia.
